CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    Donor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS receipt_count
  FROM
    donations
  GROUP BY
    Donor
),
multi_occasion_donors AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) AS multi_occasion_donor_count
  FROM
    donor_counts
  WHERE
    receipt_count > 1
),
total_amount AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
  FROM
    donations
),
multi_occasion_amount AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(Amount) AS multi_occasion_amount
  FROM
    donations d
  JOIN donor_counts dc ON d.Donor = dc.Donor
  WHERE
    dc.receipt_count > 1
)
SELECT
  (multi_occasion_amount / NULLIF(total_amount, 0)) * 100 AS fraction_percent,
  multi_occasion_donor_count AS multi_occasion_donor_count
FROM
  multi_occasion_amount, total_amount, multi_occasion_donors;
```
